prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence remains thin for all specific kinds of change, as each category has only been tested once.
Adoption redesign (adoption, redesign) was helpful and is the only tested change that won (+3.6% after noise correction).
Sign-in hints, waiting screen status info, finish notifications, and path selection redesigns showed no clear effect.
Reordering sign-in and path selection card layout changes made performance worse.
Predictions were mostly too high across tests, except for the path selection redesign where the prediction was too low (-2.0% predicted vs +0.7% noise-corrected).

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, redesign: +3.6% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, layout: -3.3% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, redesign: +0.7% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, notification: +0.3% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, wait_info: +2.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, hint: +1.5% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: -6.7% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 65.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 19.3%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Spotlight Layout for Adoption Certificate: Redesign the adoption certificate screen using a spotlight layout to highlight the pet preview and official sign-off. (why: Adoption has a high drop-off rate (65.9% conversion) and previous adoption redesign tests showed positive results (+3.6%).)
1: [choose_path, new_screen] Pet Style Selector Screen Before Path Choice: Insert a visual pet style preference screen right after the story screen to build instant visual interest. (why: Choose path screen has a long mean time of 514s; engaging users early with visual pet themes improves interest.)
2: [home, redesign] Stage Layout Companion Animation for Waiting Screen: Redesign the waiting screen into a full stage layout featuring an animated pet mascot companion. (why: Waiting on the home step takes a median of 201s and mean of 2336s; visual stage animations keep users engaged while loading.)
3: [sign_in, hint] Existing Account Warning Hint on Sign-In: Display a hint on sign-in warning users to use their existing account to avoid pet resets. (why: Support received 8 emails (the largest complaint category) about pets missing or reset after signing in again.)
4: [choose_path, copy] Desktop Companionship Story Copy Reframing: Update the story screen copy to focus directly on having a live interactive pet on your desktop. (why: Choose_path has a 76.2% conversion rate; setting clear expectations early reduces initial drop-off.)
5: [adoption, incentive] Adoption Verification Badge Incentive: Add an official adoption verification badge component on the adoption certificate screen. (why: Adoption step drops 34.1% of users; highlighting official adoption status increases completion motivation.)
6: [home, wait_info] Desktop Shortcut Tip Carousel on Waiting Screen: Add a tip carousel component to the waiting screen explaining how to interact with the pet once loaded. (why: Support received 3 emails about confusion on how to control or speak to the pet, and median waiting time is 201s.)
7: [finish, layout] Two-Column Layout for Home Intro Screen: Switch the home intro screen layout to a two-column structure separating the welcome greeting from control actions. (why: Finish step has a low 64.8% conversion and high median completion time of 395s.)
8: [adoption, new_screen] Pet Temperament Selection Screen: Insert a pet temperament selection screen prior to adoption certificate signing. (why: Adoption conversion is only 65.9%; letting users customize pet personality builds emotional connection before finalizing.)

scores.note: Adoption has high drop-off (34.1%) and adoption redesign is the only historically proven winner (+3.6%).
Adding a new screen increases friction, and previous path selection changes performed poorly.
Long waiting times on home step, but full animation redesign requires significant effort for modest expected lift.
Strong evidence from support (8 complaints) and low cost; previous sign-in hint test yielded +1.5%.
Low cost copy tweak, but evidence and historical impact for copy/path changes remain weak.
Adoption step has high drop-off; adding a verification incentive badge can improve completion motivation.
Supported by support complaints (3 emails) and long funnel wait times; wait_info previously gained +2.0%.
Finish step has high drop-off (35.2%), but layout changes have historically shown negative or negligible impact.
Adding an extra pre-adoption screen introduces friction despite adoption's high drop-off.
